build_voxelization_module: build a Voxelization nn.Module to convert KITTI point clouds into 3D voxels for SECOND detection
run_voxelization_function: run the voxelization function on a point cloud tensor with specified voxel size and coordinate range
create_dynamic_voxelize: create dynamic voxelization by passing max_points=-1 to skip fixed-size voxel output
test_hard_voxelize: test hard voxelization with deterministic flag to verify reproducible voxel output on point clouds
review_Voxelization_forward: review the Voxelization forward method that selects max_voxels based on training or testing mode
